title: AWS: review and verify an existing connection
chapter_timing: Receipt-bound logical chapters include control cue, actual transition and confirmation; durations are video times.

steps.title: 1. Review the connected account
instructions: Choose Cloud and confirm the intended provider and region.
This account already has a CryoStack access role. Select Review connection setup to inspect the saved connection.
Open CryoLauncher and sign in. Use an approved connected cloud account with its resources prepared.
The following steps select this tutorial’s model and example.
steps.why: Use the access role already registered for this account; this is not first-time account setup. The Cloud environment panel contains the account connection and its review controls.
steps.expected: Your workspace keeps scripts, datasets, run history and results together.
steps.note: Account identifiers are hidden in this tutorial. Shared application orientation; the case-specific configuration follows.

steps.title: 1. Review the connected account
instructions: Choose Cloud and confirm the intended provider and region.
This account already has a CryoStack access role. Select Review connection setup to inspect the saved connection.
steps.why: Review inspects the existing account connection without creating another role.
steps.expected: Keep the connected account and saved role unchanged.
steps.note: Account identifiers are hidden in this tutorial.

steps.title: 2. Inspect the existing setup
instructions: Review current AWS connection keeps the existing connection and saved role.
Review existing AWS stack opens its template, permissions and Outputs RoleArn for inspection.
steps.why: This form verifies the same saved role rather than replacing its trust or reconnecting the account. Its template, permissions and Outputs RoleArn explain the existing grant.
steps.expected: Console inspection is explained here; it is not filmed.
steps.note: The AWS-console inspection is explained here; it is not recorded in this clip.

steps.title: 3. Use the same saved role
instructions: Copy or paste the saved Role ARN for this same connection. Then select Verify connection.
To connect a different account, use Change AWS account rather than replacing the role in this review form.
steps.why: The review is bound to this existing connection; use Change AWS account for a different account.
steps.expected: Keep the ARN private and use the role for this same account.
steps.note: The role is masked. Entry and verification were completed during an omitted wait.

steps.title: 3. Use the same saved role
instructions: Copy or paste the saved Role ARN for this same connection. Then select Verify connection.
To connect a different account, use Change AWS account rather than replacing the role in this review form.
The recorded final state says: Verified the existing connection. No new access role was created.
Verification uses fresh temporary access and checks the AWS account identity.
steps.why: Verification uses fresh temporary access to check the AWS account identity. Checking access is separate from preparing compute resources or launching a model. This confirms account access; no new access role was created.
steps.expected: The form explicitly reports successful verification of the existing connection.
steps.note: The role is masked. Entry and verification were completed during an omitted wait. This confirms account access. It does not prepare compute resources, test MATLAB or check billing.

steps.title: 5. Continue to the run review
instructions: Connected and the updated Last verified time confirm the saved account is usable. Select Done to close the review.
Check storage, compute, image and any MATLAB readiness before launching.
steps.why: The saved connection remains available for the ordinary run-readiness checks. Account verification does not test MATLAB, prepare compute or review billing.
steps.expected: Check storage, image, compute and any MATLAB readiness before launch.
steps.note: BYO runs charge the connected AWS account. The run estimate is separate from AWS Billing.

steps.title: First connection: AWS setup
instructions: For a new connection: Connect AWS Account → Open AWS Setup → review the role template and permissions → create the stack.
Copy Outputs RoleArn back into CryoLauncher, then select Verify connection.
steps.why: This tutorial records existing-role review and verification; it does not create or run a new stack.
steps.expected: BYO model runs charge the connected AWS account; review estimated charges before launch.
steps.note: These first-time creation steps are explained, not performed. This recording reuses an existing role.
